Tunisia noun

also Tunisian

modern

M-O s.v. Tunisia (Egger)

Tūnēsia, Tūnēsiae f.

noun, first declension · Declension on Wiktionary

A country takes a preposition: in Tūnēsiam, in Tūnēsiā, ex Tūnēsiā. The quantities are those of Tūnēs, the city.

Other words

  • Tūnētānum rēgnum — the kingdom of Tunis

    also used · Renaissance · M-O s.v. Tunisia (Hofmann, 1698; Tursellinus, 1652)

See also Tunis, Carthage, Algeria, Libya.
